void format_number_compact (uint64_t value, char * out, size_t out_capacity)

Format a decimal count with lowercase k/m/b/t/p/e suffixes. Uses at most one rounded decimal place, omitting a trailing .0. Values below 1,000 stay exact; rounded 1,000-unit values promote a tier. Output is NUL-terminated when capacity is nonzero; NULL output is ignored.
